## Your company has no memory of its own.

Ecommerce teams do not have an AI problem. They have a data truth problem. Every report starts the same way: log into Shopify, then Meta, then TikTok, Amazon, Google, Klaviyo, the 3PL, the bank. Export each one. Paste it into a sheet. Reconcile the numbers that do not match. Days later you have an answer, and you still are not sure it is right.

### Dashboards disagree

Shopify says one thing. Meta says another. Finance closes the month with a third answer. You waste the meeting arguing about whose number is right.

### AI cannot see the business

Generic LLMs summarize exports. They cannot answer from live, structured context until someone builds the data layer underneath them first.

### Reporting is too slow

By the time the exports are cleaned and reconciled, the window to act has already closed. You are reporting history, not running the business.

### Actions are disconnected

The same signal that surfaces a problem should route the next move, vendor, agency, or specialist. Instead it dies in a spreadsheet.

↪ This is not an AI problem. It is a data truth problem. Modern fixes the layer underneath, so a dozen logins become one structured record, and your team and every AI you use read from the same set of numbers.
